description: This file defines models and a fetcher for searching and retrieving data from the FRED API, including query parameter classes, data models, and asynchronous data extraction and transformation methods.

classes.name: FredSearchQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for FRED search, including filters, sorting, and search type options.

classes.name: FredSearchData
classes.description: Represents the data returned from a FRED search, with alias mappings and validation.

classes.name: FredSearchFetcher
classes.description: Handles fetching and transforming FRED search data, including query transformation, data extraction, and processing.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Transforms input parameters into validated query parameters, setting defaults and handling errors.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches data from the FRED API based on query parameters.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw API response data into structured FredSearchData objects, applying filters and sorting.
